gloss: heart and soul, one's whole energy

definitions.gloss: heart and soul, one's whole energy, utmost effort
definitions.explanation: One's full spiritual and physical energy poured into something. Used to describe wholehearted dedication and effort, especially in creative or demanding work.

examples.japanese: {精魂|せいこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I put my heart and soul into creating this work.

examples.japanese: {精魂|せいこん}⟦{込|こ}めた→込める：01945_komeru⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}った→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧。
examples.english: She served food prepared with all her heart.

examples.japanese: {十年|じゅうねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歳月|さいげつ}→歳月：13198_saigetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧{精魂|せいこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傾|かたむ}けた→傾ける：11516_katamukeru⟧⟦{大作|たいさく}→大作：12196_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついに⟦{完成|かんせい}した→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: The masterpiece into which he poured his heart and soul over ten years was finally completed.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in set phrases rather than standing alone. The most common pattern is {精魂|せいこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}める→込める：01945_komeru⟧ (to put one's heart and soul into). A literary, expressive word conveying deep dedication.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精魂|せいこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}める→込める：01945_komeru⟧: to pour one's heart and soul into
- {精魂|せいこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傾|かたむ}ける→傾ける：11516_katamukeru⟧: to devote one's whole energy
- {精魂|せいこん}⟦{込|こ}めた→込める：01945_komeru⟧: made with heart and soul
